recording.provenance: Authored offline control, not captured from a model. Answers hand-scored; live judges recompute them.
recording.output: Concept journal — recover and keep the conceptual design. Reach for it when you need the design or a recorded change. Overview (context overview): read a context’s whole account, its open decisions and cuts in flight; use first when recovering a context. Design (conceptual design): read current concepts; use when their present meaning is needed. Work package — find recorded work and its dependencies. Reach for it to plan or recover a cut’s work. State (ledger): read current design concepts; use when their present meaning is needed.
